LESSON: WATER

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: RESOURCES IN OUR ENVIRONMENT Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Sugges
Topic 3.1: Water
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Water, part of RESOURCES IN OUR ENVIRONMENT Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Sugges in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we use water without wasting it? 2.Why do we care for water sources?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Water together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: Listening and Speaking Skills as learners think, pair and share experiences on careful

use of water in the home and at school.

• Learning to Learn: Working collaboratively as learners model sources of water with peers.

• Creativity and Imagination: Originality skills as learners draw and colour different sources of water.

Values:
• Unity: Equality as learners display team spirit when they participate in school water day to share experiences on using

water sparingly.

• Respect: Acceptance of peers will be enhanced as learners appreciate their diverse opinions as they think, pair and share

experiences on careful use of water in the home and school.
